```esql
FROM books
| WHERE QSTR("title:\\"return\\"", { "analyzer": "standard", "quote_analyzer": "keyword" })
| HIGHLIGHT
| KEEP title, highlight_title
| SORT title
```

| title:text | highlight_title:keyword |
| --- | --- |
| Return of the King Being the Third Part of The Lord of the Rings | <em>Return</em> of the King Being the Third Part of The Lord of the Rings |
| Return of the Shadow | <em>Return</em> of the Shadow |
